annotations.title: Save Vocabulary to My IELTSera Flashcards

description: Authenticated Tool (Requires IELTSera Personal Access Token): Saves a vocabulary word or collocation from the conversation into the connected learner's IELTSera spaced-repetition flashcard progress and bookmarks it in their Learning Hub.

contextNote.description: Optional example sentence or usage note discussed during the chat.

term.description: The English word, academic collocation, or card ID to save to the learner's IELTSera vocabulary deck.
